purpose: Define the review-only implementation boundary, deterministic algorithm, error contract, and exhaustive negative-test plan for the accepted allowlisted coordinate consumer. This file does not contain production consumer code and does not authorize runtime bindings or renderer use.

implementation_boundary.planned_module: isolated review-only GDScript RefCounted helper, not in production call graph
implementation_boundary.output_lifetime: in-memory return value only; no JSON serialization, file writes, logs containing inputs, payload store, or renderer handoff
implementation_boundary.asset_contract_handling: use only the pinned asset path and static intrinsic-dimension contract; do not load SVG or create texture/Node2D/Sprite2D during this gate
implementation_boundary.not_yet_decided: the production call site and binding approval remain a later formal gate; this design must not guess or add that call site

candidate_id.rule: exact, case-sensitive candidate ID; no aliases, trimming, numeric coercion, or inference from frame data

simulation_result.rule: must be the same object associated with upstream validation and must expose the existing frames array

upstream_validation.origin: the result of SimulationResult.validate_contract(expected_game_frames) for this exact SimulationResult

input_contract.frame_sequence: SimulationResult.frames in current array order; no winning_frame filtering and no custom sorting
input_contract.frame_index_source: zero-based local array ordinal i; do not read a snapshot frame_index field
input_contract.custom_data_access: exactly one Dictionary.get(allowlisted_key, unique_missing_sentinel) per source frame; never pair has() with a second index/get read
input_contract.snapshot_access: for projection read only the exact allowlisted custom_data key; asset path and projection constants come from the pinned contract, not the snapshot
input_contract.no_enumeration_or_copy: do not enumerate, duplicate, merge, stringify, log, hash, or serialize custom_data or any full snapshot object
input_contract.atomicity: all frames validate before a success track is returned; any invalid sample discards all local partial frame entries and returns only a safe error envelope

validation_pipeline.name: projection_stage_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: require the call to be from the isolated review-only test entry point; no production or renderer-dispatch caller exists

validation_pipeline.name: candidate_id_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: exact match to one of the four accepted candidate IDs

validation_pipeline.name: candidate_field_pair_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: bind exactly the single field specified for the accepted ID; no caller-supplied field argument

validation_pipeline.name: upstream_contract_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: require valid upstream SimulationResult contract proof for the exact object and expected frame count

validation_pipeline.name: source_frame_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: require nonempty Array[FrameSnapshot] and preserve its exact cardinality/order

validation_pipeline.name: asset_contract_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: require pinned target asset path and approved 100x100 intrinsic size contract, but do not load the resource

validation_pipeline.name: single_key_extraction
validation_pipeline.rule: exactly one Dictionary.get(allowlisted_key, unique_missing_sentinel) per source frame; never pair has() with a second index/get read

validation_pipeline.name: strict_type_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: CHALLENGE_003: int/float only, excluding bool; CHALLENGE_005/006/007: exactly Vector2; no string/array/dictionary coercion

validation_pipeline.name: finite_value_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: reject NaN and both infinities in scalar or either vector component

validation_pipeline.name: inclusive_domain_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: enforce per-spec coordinate domain without clamp or round

validation_pipeline.name: per_run_invariant_gate
validation_pipeline.rule: for CHALLENGE_005 every target_position must exactly equal the first accepted same-run Vector2

validation_pipeline.name: ordered_projection
validation_pipeline.rule: emit one in-memory frame descriptor per source frame at ordinal i; apply only the spec transform and constants

validation_pipeline.name: closed_output_check
validation_pipeline.rule: success object contains exactly the output-contract root/frame/marker keys and no source or simulation fields

validation_pipeline.name: atomic_return
validation_pipeline.rule: return complete logical track on full success; otherwise return no projected track and no partial samples

coordinate_contract.delivery_profile: REVIEW_720 is reference-only; this consumer must not apply delivery scaling
coordinate_contract.source_timeline: one sample per existing source frame; no interpolation, extrapolation, resampling, duplication, winning_frame remapping, or temporal smoothing

failure_contract.error_message_policy: stable failure code only; do not interpolate source values into messages

failure_codes.trigger: candidate_id is not exactly one of the four allowlisted IDs
candidate ID and exact field pair do not match the contract
validated source frame sequence is empty
upstream SimulationResult contract proof is missing, invalid, or not tied to this exact result
one source frame lacks its one exact allowlisted custom_data key
scalar is not int/float or vector is not exactly Vector2; booleans are never numbers
scalar or any Vector2 component is NaN or infinite
Vector2 x/y lies outside inclusive [0,1080] x [0,1920]
input/validation frame count is inconsistent; no synthetic samples are permitted
source ordinal invariant cannot be proven; never fall back to frame metadata
CHALLENGE_005 target_position differs from its first valid same-run Vector2
pinned TARGET SVG does not match approved 100x100 intrinsic dimensions
attempt is made from an unapproved stage or to reach renderer dispatch

negative_families.generation: 4 allowlisted candidate ids x 3 wrong fields from other accepted entries
4 exact candidate-field pairs x invalid location at first/middle/last source frame
11 invalid variants x first/middle/last source frame
17 invalid variants x 3 vector candidates x first/middle/last source frame
all four supported candidate-field pairs with zero source frames
each supported candidate at an invalid first/middle/last frame following/before valid samples
first mismatch at frame 1 and last frame

negative_families.test_oracle: assert exact success-output keys and zero source-data leakage; this is a test assertion, not a consumer failure code

negative_test_contract.atomicity_oracle: every invalid track returns no projected track and never exposes an accepted prefix
negative_test_contract.strict_type_policy: bool is rejected as a number; scalar int/float only; vector must be Vector2; never coerce
negative_test_contract.boundary_policy: inclusive coordinate bounds; epsilon outside fails; no clamp or rounding
negative_test_contract.closed_output_policy: exact key sets only at root, frame and marker levels; source values and custom_data never flow to output
coverage_requirements: all 12 wrong cross-pairings among the accepted candidates and their fields
scalar invalid classes at first/middle/last frame
vector invalid classes for every vector candidate at first/middle/last frame
missing source key at first/middle/last frame
zero source frames for every supported candidate
atomic failure for every candidate and frame position
CHALLENGE_005 run-constant violation at multiple positions
closed output and forbidden data leakage mutation tests

planned_positive_families: all four exact allowlisted candidate-field pairs
inclusive domain endpoints for scalar and vectors
vector transform corners and center without rounding/clamping
source frame order/cardinality on multi-frame tracks
CHALLENGE_005 identical per-run vector repeated for every frame
CHALLENGE_006 and CHALLENGE_007 accept dynamic per-frame vectors
unrelated custom_data keys remain unread and absent from output
all successful output levels have exact closed keysets
